title: Landfall ThemeSchema v1.0
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for Landfall theme YAML/JSON files. Mirrors the validation rules enforced by ThemeValidator.validate().

version.description: Schema version. Must be exactly the string "1.0".

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file content with this line stripped. Required when distributing themes via URL (A08 integrity check). Computed as: sha256(file_content_without_sha256_line).

name.description: Display name for this theme. Max 60 characters.

description.description: One or two sentences describing the theme. Max 200 characters.

previewUrl.description: Absolute HTTPS URL to a 1920x1080 PNG preview image.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. "MIT", "Apache-2.0") or the string "proprietary".

type.description: Background rendering mode. "image" requires a Pro license on the display.

value.description: For solid: 3 or 6-digit hex (e.g. "#0D0D0F"). For gradient: JSON-encoded stop array. For image: absolute HTTPS URL. For blur: integer string representing blur radius in px.

overlay.description: Optional rgba color drawn on top of image/gradient backgrounds to ensure card legibility.

fill.description: Card body background color. Default: rgba(255,255,255,0.05).

radius.description: Corner radius in dp. 0 = square corners. Default: 8.

blur.description: Backdrop blur in px behind the card fill. Creates frosted glass effect. Default: 0.

shadow.description: Drop shadow beneath cards. Default: none.

fontFamily.description: Base font family. Must match a name from the Landfall Font Registry. Default: "System".

scale.description: Text size multiplier. compact = -15%, comfortable = baseline, display = +20%. Default: comfortable.

weight.description: Font weight for card titles and section headers. Must be a multiple of 100. Default: 600.
Font weight for card body text and secondary content. Must be a multiple of 100. Default: 400.

letterSpacing.description: Letter spacing: tight = -0.5px, normal = 0, wide = +1.0px at base scale. Default: normal.

fontFamily.description: Clock widget font family override. Inherits base fontFamily if not set.

weight.description: Clock widget font weight. Must be a multiple of 100. Default: 200.

accent.description: Primary interactive and highlight color. Default: #4A9EFF.

accentMuted.description: Softer version of accent. Derived from accent at 0.2 alpha if not set.

primary.description: Primary text color for titles and most prominent text. Default: #FFFFFF.

secondary.description: Supporting text color for subtitles and secondary data. Default: rgba(255,255,255,0.6).

tertiary.description: Caption-level text color for timestamps and least-prominent text. Default: rgba(255,255,255,0.35).

divider.description: Separator color for list items and grid lines. Derived from text.primary at 0.1 alpha if not set.

border.description: Border color for agent-pushed cards. Derived from accent at 0.3 alpha if not set.

success.description: Positive semantic color used in success mood rendering. Default: #34C759.

warning.description: Warning semantic color used in system status indicators. Default: #FF9F0A.

alert.description: Error and alert semantic color used in urgent mood rendering. Default: #FF3B30.

transition.description: How content within a card transitions on data refresh. Default: fade.

speed.description: Animation duration multiplier: fast = 150ms, normal = 300ms, relaxed = 500ms. Default: normal.

cardEntry.description: How new cards enter the grid when a layout change occurs. Default: fade.

tickerScroll.description: Scroll speed for the ghost ticker strip. Default: normal.

moods.description: Per-mood visual treatment tokens. Every token is optional; unset tokens fall back to documented defaults.

urgent.description: Applied to cards pushed with mood: "urgent". Represents time-sensitive or problem-state content.

pulse.description: When true, the card border animates with a slow pulse. Default: true.

scale.description: Card scale relative to its slot. Default: 1.01.

celebratory.description: Applied to cards pushed with mood: "celebratory". Represents milestones, achievements, high-energy positive events.

success.description: Applied to cards pushed with mood: "success". Represents positive outcomes and completed goals. Lower intensity than celebratory.

muted.description: Applied to cards pushed with mood: "muted". Represents low-priority or background-awareness content.

opacity.description: Opacity applied to the entire card widget. Do not set below 0.3 — content becomes unreadable at TV viewing distances. Default: 0.5.

hex.description: 3 or 6-digit hex color string with leading #. Example: "#4A9EFF" or "#FFF".

rgba.description: CSS rgba color string. r/g/b are 0-255, alpha is 0.0-1.0. Example: "rgba(74, 158, 255, 0.3)".

fontRegistryName.description: A font name from the Landfall Font Registry. Using an unrecognized name produces a validation warning and falls back to "System".
